label: Qt 5
source: doc: plan 2.2 and learn.microsoft.com UIA overview (2026-10-24)
notes: Qt 5 exposes UIA through its MSAA bridge: names yes, AutomationIds rarely (to verify by probe).

quirks.text: Qt 5.15 exports the objectName chain as AutomationId (e.g. 'MsgBoxCritical.qt_msgbox_label'), so locators get stable AutomationIds where the program names its widgets.
QMessageBox is a Window (AutomationId 'MsgBox<Icon>') whose buttons sit in a Group '<id>.qt_msgbox_buttonbox'; Button + Invoke answers it.
